prompt: An object has a constant acceleration of $2.5$ meters per second squared. What is this acceleration, in feet per minute squared? ($1$ meter $= 3.28$ feet)
explanation: Choice C is correct. Convert meters to feet: $2.5 \times 3.28 = 8.2$ feet per second squared. Convert seconds squared to minutes squared: since $1$ minute $= 60$ seconds, multiply by $60^2 = 3{,}600$. Therefore, $8.2 \times 3{,}600 = 29{,}520$ feet per minute squared.
